Upgrade of the R336 between Addo and Nqweba Phase 2, Eastern Cape

Eastern Cape, 26 June 2025 —The South African National Roads Agency SOC Limited (SANRAL) wishes to inform road users about the ongoing road upgrade project on the R336 Phase two section, which extends from Bezuidenhout River (approximately 13 km from Nqweba Town (formerly Kirkwood Town) to the intersection of the R336 and R335 near Addo. The project is scheduled to continue until December 2025.

On the occasion of Sri Jagannath Ratha Yatra, organized by ISKCON Abids, a grand religious procession will take place on 27th June 2025 (Friday), 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM. From NTR Stadium, Indira Park to Exhibition Grounds

𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗲:

1. Dharna Chowk
2. Left turn → Ashoknagar X Roads
3. RTC X Roads
4. Right turn → Narayanguda X Roads
5. Right turn → Himayatnagar Y Junction
6. Liberty X Roads
7. Left turn → Basheerbagh X Roads (under the flyover)
8. BJR Circle
9. SBI Gunfoundry
10. Chermas
11. Taj Mahal Junction
12. Bata T Junction
13. GPO Circle
14. Yusuf & Company
15. MJ Market Cross Roads
16. Right turn → Malakunta
17. Ends at Exhibition Grounds

𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁:

• Expect traffic congestion and vehicle stoppages/diversions along the above route.

• Traffic will be regulated or diverted depending on the procession’s movement.

𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗺𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗔𝗱𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗿𝘆:

• Avoid the procession route between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

• Use alternative routes to prevent delays and ensure smooth travel.

• Kindly cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.
